sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is semantically verified for a ship-owned displacement path or representation that explicitly associates each displacement with its corresponding UIWL.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicable branch to encode the complete comparisonModel. The forward-draught calculation must use the displacement associated with the UIWL waterline having the greatest displacement when multiple UIWL waterlines exist; use the supplied canonical relationship/terms hasUpperIceWaterline, waterlineDisplacement, and the corresponding UIWL selection structure rather than an unqualified ship-level displacementAtUpperIceWaterline. Enforce the derived-threshold comparison with a tolerance scaled from the expected formula result, not an exact zero-tolerance comparison.
